Intel: Python code with syntax errors should report diagnostics

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { ProcessConfig, process } from "@xberg-io/tree-sitter-language-pack";
function main() {
  const config: ProcessConfig = { diagnostics: true, language: "python" };
  const result = process("def broken(\n    pass\n", config);
  console.log(result.language);
  console.log(result.metrics?.errorCount);
  console.log(result.diagnostics);
}

void main();
```
